name: NGC 4605 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4605, a dwarf spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc4605-hubble
story: This view looks at the eastern side of NGC 4605, a dwarf spiral galaxy, where Hubble resolved the disk into individual stars. The brightest of its old giant stars served as a yardstick for the galaxy's distance.

claims.text: NGC 4605 is a dwarf spiral galaxy with a bar
The Hubble ACS field was pointed on the eastern side of NGC 4605
The field was resolved into individual stars, mostly red giant branch stars
The tip of the red giant branch gave the galaxy's distance
